## 🔴 High Impact

### NFLX — Netflix | **BEARISH**
**Q3 2026 earnings released after hours today. Revenue fell short of estimates — stock tanking.**

Netflix reported Q3 2026 results after market close today. Revenue missed Wall Street estimates, prompting analyst commentary of "Nothing here to get excited about." The stock has now fallen after five consecutive earnings reports and is down ~25% year-to-date in 2026. HSBC downgraded the stock ahead of results. Ad-tier scale and password-sharing monetization were meant to buoy growth, but slower subscriber engagement continues to weigh.

- **Why it matters:** 6th straight post-earnings decline is a structural concern. The revenue miss deepens the bear case for NFLX at a time when the stock is already deeply in the red for the year.
- Sources: [Yahoo Finance – Q3 revenue miss](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/netflix-stock-tanks-as-q3-revenue-falls-short-nothing-here-to-get-excited-about-201022485.html) | [Benzinga – 5 straight declines](https://www.benzinga.com/trading-ideas/previews/26/10/62453726/netflix-stock-fallen-5-straight-reports-will-q3-break-the-streak) | [TipRanks – Q3 earnings date](https://www.tipranks.com/news/netflix-will-report-q3-earnings-on-october-20-options-traders-brace-for-a-9-57-move-in-nflx-stock)

### SPCX — SpaceX | **WATCH (Mixed)**
**Q3 2026 earnings webcast TODAY at 3:30 PM CT. Revenue expected ~$12.9–$13B. Potential first profitable quarter post-IPO.**

SpaceX confirmed its Q3 2026 financial results and live webcast for today. Analysts forecast revenue surging to $13B with AI infrastructure services increasingly taking center stage alongside Starlink. The key test: can AI revenue exceed $6.4B and does the company post its first public-company profit? Options market pricing in a ~7.8% move. Post-earnings reaction will be closely watched given the Tesla-SpaceX merger speculation (see Upcoming Catalysts).

- **Why it matters:** SpaceX AI business is becoming a major growth story. A beat with profitability would validate the AI hyperscaler thesis and likely boost TSLA too, given merger speculation.
- Sources: [SpaceX IR](https://ir.spacex.com/updates/releases/details/2026/SpaceX-to-Post-Third-Quarter-2026-Results-and-Host-Webcast-on-October-20-2026-2026-QssQGye3im/default.aspx) | [TipRanks Q3 preview](https://www.tipranks.com/news/spacex-q3-earnings-preview-options-market-signals-7-8-move-as-analysts-forecast-12-9b-revenue) | [Seeking Alpha – AI revenue](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4654451-spacex-q3-earnings-revenue-seen-surging-to-13b-as-ai-business-takes-centre-stage)
